title: Number Initials
prompt: What letter comes next in this sequence?
O, T, T, F, F, S, S, E, N, T, ?
hints: There are 11 letters shown so far. The next would be the 12th.
Try reading each letter as the initial of a counting word: One, Two, Three…
One, Two, Three, Four, Five, Six, Seven, Eight, Nine, Ten, Eleven — what's next?
solution_lede: Each letter is the first letter of the counting numbers in sequence: One, Two, Three, Four, Five, Six, Seven, Eight, Nine, Ten, Eleven. The next number is Twelve, whose initial is E.

solution_steps.body: O=One, T=Two, T=Three, F=Four, F=Five, S=Six, S=Seven, E=Eight, N=Nine, T=Ten, E=Eleven.
Wait — there are only 10 letters shown. The 11th is T=Ten and the pattern continues to the 12th.
After Ten (T) comes Eleven (E). The answer is E.
